audit_items.proof_trace: Decoder assumes StatusCode ∈ {0,1} but receipt field is byte (0-255). If StatusCode≥2 is encoded, decoder misinterprets it as GasUsedTotal (line 53-56), corrupting all subsequent fields. EofStatusCode.Failure=2 exists but no current code path writes it to receipts.
audit_items.attack_scenario: If EOF or future upgrade writes StatusCode=2 to receipts, P2P receipt propagation and block sync will silently produce corrupt receipt data, breaking receipt root validation and event log queries.
